assertionResults.reason: The live dashboard rendered active panels as solid dark navy surfaces in the screenshots. No user-visible glass/translucent panel effect was observed while inspecting the mounted page, even though one DOM-inspected section used an opaque dark gradient background image over a transparent base color.

The rendered page showed a clean dark background without visible galaxy, parallax, vignette, or star-field effects. The visible text captured from the page did not include 'galaxy model dock' or 'in-galaxy management'; the button text was simply 'model dock'.

Narrative residue is still visible in live user-facing labels and status copy. The page text and screenshots showed 'witness thread', 'view lens keeper', 'anchor registry', 'fork tax canticle', 'receipt river', and 'Glass lane preferred during low-priority cycle.'

frictions.description: The Threat Radar card visibly showed 'Failed to fetch' during inspection because backend-connected data was unavailable.
frictions.resolution: Per the assignment, this was treated as expected backend absence and the validation stayed focused on user-visible labels/backgrounds.

frictions.description: agent-browser's network request capture returned 'No requests captured' for this session even though the UI displayed a failed-fetch state.
frictions.resolution: Used screenshots, extracted body text, console/error output, and DOM inspection instead of relying on the network capture output.

summary: Validated VAL-UI-001, VAL-UI-003, and VAL-UI-006 on the live Vite dashboard. Active panels visibly render as solid dark surfaces and no galaxy/parallax background residue was seen, but narrative labels remain visible in multiple panels and status lines, so VAL-UI-006 still fails.
